name: snail-race
description: Carreras de caracoles: registro local, dashboard y recarga de saldo con la pasarela simulada SnailPay

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @snail-race/api" "npm run dev -w @snail-race/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @snail-race/api && npm run build -w @snail-race/web
scripts.check: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run format && npm test
